mapper.select: SELECT FROM behavior_history_item i LEFT JOIN behavior_event_outbox o USING(event_id) LIMIT 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_history_command(command_id,source_id,manifest_json,manifest_sha256,item_count,actor,reason) VALUES(#{id},#{source},#{manifest},encode(sha256(convert_to(#{manifest},'UTF8')),'hex'),#{count},#{actor},#{reason}) ON CONFLICT(command_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM behavior_history_command WHERE command_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE behavior_history_command SET visit_sequence=visit_sequence+1 WHERE command_id=#{id} AND status='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_behavior WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.event_id,o.last_error AS error, (b.id IS NOT NULL AND o.source_snapshot_sha256<>encode(sha256(convert_to(behavior_source_snapshot(b),'UTF8')),'hex')) AS source_changed FROM behavior_event_outbox o LEFT JOIN user_behavior b ON b.id=o.behavior_id WHERE o.behavior_id=#{id} AND o.source_id=(SELECT source_id FROM behavior_event_source WHERE singleton) FOR UPDATE OF o
mapper.update: UPDATE behavior_history_item SET status=#{status},event_id=#{event},error_code=#{error},checked_at=clock_timestamp(), last_visit=(SELECT visit_sequence FROM behavior_history_command WHERE command_id=#{command}) WHERE command_id=#{command} AND behavior_id=#{id} AND status='WAITING_SOURCE'

UPDATE behavior_history_command SET completed_at=clock_timestamp(),status=CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM behavior_history_item WHERE command_id=#{id} AND status IN ('INVALID_SOURCE','SOURCE_CHANGED')) THEN 'COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES' ELSE 'COMPLETE' END WHERE command_id=#{id} AND status='OPEN' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM behavior_history_item WHERE command_id=#{id} AND status='WAITING_SOURCE')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM behavior_history_item i LEFT JOIN behavior_event_outbox o USING(event_id) WHERE i.command_id=#{id} ORDER BY i.behavior_id LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_history_cancel(cancel_id,command_id,actor,reason,previous_status,result) VALUES(#{id},#{command},#{actor},#{reason},#{previous},#{result}) ON CONFLICT(cancel_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE behavior_history_command SET status='CANCELLED',completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE command_id=#{id} AND status='OPEN'
